captions.detailed: A 3D model of a BMX bicycle crankset featuring a three-piece crank configuration. The central assembly includes a dark cylindrical bottom bracket spindle with silver collars, which connects two grey, tapered crank arms oriented in opposite directions. Mounted on the right arm is a large, metallic grey sprocket wheel with stylized weight-reduction cutouts and outer gear teeth. At the ends of both crank arms, black rectangular platform pedals with integrated traction pins are attached via silver axle joints, allowing them to spin freely.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a BMX crankset. The assembly must include a central bottom bracket spindle, two opposing crank arms, a detailed multi-toothed drive sprocket on the right arm, and two rectangular platform pedals with grip pins attached to the crank tips via revolute joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs the crankset by first modeling the bottom bracket spindle using stacked concentric cylinders. The crank arms are created by extruding a 2D sketch that lofts between two circles of different diameters, which are then positioned at opposing 180-degree angles on the spindle. The sprocket is designed by patterning teeth and circular cutouts around a central disk, then mounting it to the right crank arm. Finally, the pedals are modeled using box primitives for the outer rectangular frames, combined with small cylindrical pins, and are attached to the crank arm tips via revolute joint definitions.
